## Natural-language intents
- assess an IBM i or AS/400 estate before changing production
- IBM i estate assessment
- AS/400 estate assessment
- find undocumented dependencies in an IBM i workload
- map RPG CL COBOL DB2 jobs and integrations before IBM i modernization
- I am worried an IBM i upgrade will break batch jobs interfaces or vendor software
- build a rollback test and evidence plan before changing an IBM i production system

- IBM i 7.4 support is ending and I need an upgrade plan

## Boundaries
- support transition does not mean a system automatically stops working
- a direct upgrade path is not assumed until exact release hardware PTF application database driver integration and vendor dependencies are verified
- checkout creation is not payment proof
- paid state requires authoritative provider verification
- no production change or cutover is included in the public X-Ray or Proof Sprint
- Human buyer route reachability and backend checkout creation are live-verified with synthetic QA
- Checkout creation is not payment proof; provider verification is still required before paid state or revenue claims
- unknown IBM i release is acceptable and must not be guessed from generic technology-use evidence

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
